subject.text: Laptop is completely dead, won't turn on

description.text: This morning my laptop shut down by itself while I was using it, and now pressing the power button does nothing.
I plugged the charger into the power strip under my desk.
The small light on the power strip switch is off, and the switch is in the OFF position.
Could the machine be burnt out? It was still fine yesterday.

history.text: Two weeks ago: routine check, battery healthy at 94%.

explanation: The power strip switch is OFF, so the charger delivers no power and the healthy battery finally ran out. Guide Bayu to turn the switch on, wait a moment for the battery to charge, then turn the laptop on.
hints: Before suspecting the machine, check the power path from the wall socket to the laptop.
Look at the light and the switch position on the power strip the charger is plugged into.
